Pak Compliance Setup Guide
Complete the following steps in FBR E-Invoicing Setup to activate FBR E-Invoicing.
name: FBR Setup Instructions Block
script:
(async function () { const container = root_element.querySelector('#fbr-setup-instructions'); const list = root_element.querySelector('#fbr-setup-steps'); const error = root_element.querySelector('#fbr-setup-error'); if (!container || !list) { return; } const renderStep = function (label, complete) { const statusClass = complete ? 'complete' : 'pending'; const statusText = complete ? 'Complete' : 'Pending'; return '
  • ' + label + '' + statusText + '
    • '; }; try { const r = await frappe.call({ method: 'fbr_e_invoicing.utils.get_fbr_setup_status' }); const status = (r && r.message) || {}; if (!status.show_instructions) { container.style.display = 'none'; return; } const steps = [ { label: 'Enter the FBR API Endpoint', complete: !status.endpoint_missing }, { label: 'Enter the PRAL Authorization Token', complete: !status.token_missing }, { label: 'Click Fetch Master Data', complete: !status.master_data_missing } ]; list.innerHTML = steps.map(function (step) { return renderStep(step.label, step.complete); }).join(''); } catch (e) { if (error) { error.textContent = 'Unable to load setup status right now.'; error.style.display = 'block'; } } })();
style: .fbr-setup-box { border: 1px solid #d4dce6; border-radius: 8px; background: #f8fafc; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .fbr-setup-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #1f2937; margin-bottom: 6px; } .fbr-setup-subtitle { font-size: 13px; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 6px; } .fbr-setup-subtitle a { color: #1e3a8a; text-decoration: underline; } .fbr-setup-list { list-style: disc; margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; } .fbr-setup-list li { margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .step-label { color: #1f2937; font-size: 13px; } .step-status { font-size: 11px; line-height: 1; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; } .step-status.complete { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; border: 1px solid #86efac; } .step-status.pending { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; border: 1px solid #fcd34d; } .fbr-setup-error { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: #b91c1c; }
